headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 28, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners fell to the Texas Rangers in a 7-3 showdown, with Joc Pederson leading the offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. Kumar Rocker earned the win for the Rangers, pitching 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

Several teams suffered injuries, impacting their lineups and rotations. The Kansas City Royals placed RHP Beck Way on the 15-day injured list due to low back spasms/tightness. The Minnesota Twins placed RHP Cole Sands on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 27, 2026, with a right elbow strain. The Detroit Tigers placed RF Kerry Carpenter on the 10-day injured list with left foot plantar fasciitis. The Cincinnati Reds placed 1B Spencer Steer on the 10-day injured list with a right wrist sprain. The New York Yankees placed LF Cody Bellinger on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain.

Several trades and roster moves took place, including the Baltimore Orioles trading RF Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The San Diego Padres signed SS Nu'u Contrades, while the St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Felix Doroteo. The Boston Red Sox traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Rangers in 7-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 loss to the Texas Rangers, with Joc Pederson leading the offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. Kumar Rocker earned the win for the Rangers, pitching 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Tigers 8-5**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their matchup. Coby Mayo led the Orioles' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Diamondbacks in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Mason Montgomery earning the win. Max Kepler led the Diamondbacks' offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall Short in Miami**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dropped a close game to the Miami Marlins, losing 8-7. Heriberto Hernández led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Reds in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Cincinnati Reds, with multiple players contributing to the outcome. José Ramírez and Kyle Manzardo were among the Guardians' impact hitters, while Tyler Stephenson and Elly De La Cruz had notable performances for the Reds.

top_news.title: **Mets Shut Down Braves in Thrilling Tiebreaker**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 0-0 victory over the Atlanta Braves, claiming the win in a game that ended in a scoreless tie.

top_news.title: **Royals RHP Beck Way Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-hander Beck Way has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to low back spasms/tightness.

top_news.title: **Rodríguez Traded to Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RF Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash on July 27, 2026. Rodríguez will join the Pirates' roster following the trade.
